subject: Private renewal: request to add isolated analytics cluster + term adjustment
messages:
From: Alex Sanders <alex.sanders@beaconhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@beaconhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private environment renewal + analytics isolation request

Hi Irene,

We’re approaching our contract renewal for the Private deployment (renewal due 2026-09-30). During Q3 planning our analytics team flagged a new requirement: they want an isolated analytics cluster (separate VPC/networking and additional cluster nodes) to run heavier model evals and PII-scoped analytics without touching the primary inference clusters.

Can Redwood provide an addendum that: 
- Adds a dedicated analytics cluster (3 GPU nodes, autoscaling to 6) in our existing VPC region (us-west-2)
- Ensures network isolation (no cross-VPC access from primary cluster) and a separate KMS key for analytics data
- Gives us a 12-month term extension but with a 30-day early-termination option for the analytics cluster only (we want flexibility to evaluate it)

I’ve looped Procurement on CC (contracts@beaconhealth.com). Please advise on pricing delta and any SOC/compliance notes we need to attach.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Sanders
Head of Platform Engineering
Beacon HealthTech
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0168

Attachment: capacity-requirements-analytics.xlsx (sent earlier via Drive)
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alex Sanders <alex.sanders@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private environment renewal + analytics isolation request

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to run this through a quick feasibility + pricing pass.

Quick notes up front:
- We can provision a dedicated analytics cluster in us-west-2 with strict VPC isolation and a separate KMS key. Network isolation will be enforced at routing and security-group layers; we’ll also provision a private peering endpoint for controlled data egress if needed.
- Our standard node sizing for analytics workloads uses p4d-style instances; I’ve asked Rafael to draft a capacity estimate and cost delta.
- Term amendment is doable — 12 months for the analytics cluster with a 30-day early-termination clause scoped to the analytics environment only. We’ll need legal to prepare an addendum to the Master Services Agreement.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Rafael to share a capacity + pricing estimate by EOD tomorrow.
2) Stephanie (legal) to prepare an addendum template and a short redline the week of Aug 24.
3) I’ll assemble a one-page summary for Beacon Procurement to accelerate approvals.

Ben — can you join to capture any commercial levers (credits, pilot pricing, volume discount) we should offer?

Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: none in this reply
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Alex Sanders <alex.sanders@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private environment renewal + analytics isolation request

Alex / team — attached is a preliminary capacity estimate and run-rate delta for the analytics cluster. Summary below: 

- Baseline: 3 dedicated GPU nodes (NVIDIA A40-equivalent), burst to 6 nodes for eval windows.
- Estimated sustained token throughput for evaluations: ~120k tokens/min; peak test windows up to 350k tokens/min for short bursts.
- Monthly incremental cost (on Dedicated pricing): $36,500/mo for baseline 3-node pool; burst capacity billed per-minute during windows (estimate additional $7–12k/mo depending on burst frequency).
- One-time provisioning + isolation engineering: flat $9,000 (includes VPC setup, KMS integration, and an Ops runbook).

I’ve attached: capacity-estimate-2026Q4.csv and a draft SOW outline (SOW-beacon-analytics-draft.pdf). 

Security notes: provisioning separate KMS keys and network ACLs is standard; we’ll run the SOC/ISO artifacts and can annotate the security questionnaire your team sent.

Let me know if you want a cheaper quantized profile for evaluation (lower-cost inference but with quality tradeoffs).

-Rafael

Attachments: capacity-estimate-2026Q4.csv; SOW-beacon-analytics-draft.pdf
From: Contracts Team <contracts@beaconhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Sanders <alex.sanders@beaconhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private environment renewal + analytics isolation request

Hi Stephanie and Irene,

Thanks for the quick responses. A few contract items the Procurement team will need in the addendum: 
- Explicit scope for the analytics cluster (node counts, region, expected burst limits)
- Isolation clause language ensuring data segregation and separate KMS ownership
- Early termination mechanics and any wind-down fees (we prefer no more than a 30-day notice window and minimal wind-down fees)
- SLA expectations for the analytics cluster (availability and mean time to recover)

We attached a partially completed security questionnaire (security-questionnaire-beacon.xlsx). Can Redwood confirm which controls map to our SOC 2 sections so we can expedite internal signoff?

Also, can Redwood provide a short pricing option with a 3-month pilot rate (discounted) to evaluate with our analytics team before committing to the full annual term?

Thanks,
Priya Verma
Contracts Manager
Beacon HealthTech

Attachment: security-questionnaire-beacon.xlsx
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Contracts Team <contracts@beaconhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private environment renewal + analytics isolation request

Hi Priya / Alex — copying legal and commercial next steps.

We can accommodate the items you listed. Plan/commitments: 
1) SOW will enumerate exact node counts and burst thresholds (Rafael included those estimates in the attached).
2) Addendum will include: explicit isolation language, KMS separation, and a 30-day early-termination right for the analytics environment. Wind-down fees: waived if notice given with at least 30 days; shorter notice windows may incur a prorated provisioning fee (we’ll call that out in the addendum).
3) SLA: we’ll offer 99.5% availability on the dedicated analytics cluster with the same incident escalation path as your primary environment.
4) Pilot pricing: we’ll offer a 60% discounted pilot rate for the first 3 months on baseline 3-node configuration. After pilot, standard monthly run-rate applies unless Beacon signs an expanded reserved commit.

I’m attaching a draft addendum + SOW. If that looks good we can put the DocuSign link in the thread next week and target signature before 2026-09-01.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-beacon-analytics-draft.pdf; security-questionnaire-beacon.xlsx
